data.text: kadence hook prompt is over the 200 ms budget on this repository's own journal before KAD-78 too: median 210-214 ms at HEAD febb9bb (12-25 runs, interleaved, 'Let's add embeddings…' prompt), 215-221 ms after KAD-78. In process, rejectedMatches and search each take ~42-46 ms with no measurable difference between the two; the rest is start-up and a second pass over the corpus (search, then rejectedMatches, each builds its own index). Not covered by test/perf.test.ts, which times loadOrBuild only.
